title: Claude/kbs dogfood rough edges
description:
Ryan 2026-09-09 dogfood: Claude used kbs against the Kanbus editorial workflow and hit several rough edges that slow agent work. Track remediation here.

## Context

- Editorial workflow rejects story+open as an invalid combination; Claude had to discover and run kbs move to task manually.
- Optional Mosquitto broker missing prints a warning on every kbs invocation instead of once or on demand.
- Markus render binary naming collides with the unrelated PyPI markus package in docs and onboarding.

## Goal

Smooth the Claude/kbs dogfood path so agents get actionable hints instead of silent invalid states or noisy warnings.
